sloka: स भूत्वा शैलसङ्काशः क्षणेन पुनरात्मवान् ।ह्रस्वतां परमां प्राप्तो बन्धनान्यवशातयत् ।। 5.53.41।।।।
transliteration: sa bhūtvā śailasaṅkāśaḥ kṣaṇena punarātmavān ।hrasvatāṁ paramāṁ prāpto bandhanānyavaśātayat ।। 5.53.41।।।।

translations.english: Illustrious Hanuman was relieved of the bond and once again grew to a mountain size. Looking around he saw an iron club near the archway.
